when.sl: Ko se kaznivo dejanje dogaja zdaj: neznanec je na poti k vam po denar ali nakit, »kurir« ali »policist« stoji pred vrati, ali vas nekdo ogroža. Pokličite sami, nikoli prek številke, ki vam jo da klicatelj.
when.en: When the crime is happening now: a stranger is on the way to collect money or jewellery, a “courier” or “police officer” is at the door, or someone is threatening you. Dial it yourself, never through a number a caller gives you.

when.sl: Za nujno pomoč policije in za prijavo goljufije ali poskusa goljufije, tudi telefonske (lažni policist, lažni sorodnik v nesreči, lažni bančni uslužbenec). Prijavo lahko podate tudi na najbližji policijski postaji.
when.en: For urgent police help and to report a fraud or attempted fraud, including by phone (fake police officer, fake relative in an accident, fake bank employee). You can also report at the nearest police station.

when.sl: Za prijavo spletne goljufije, ki se ne dogaja v tem trenutku: lažna plačilna povezava, lažna trgovina, naložbena ali ljubezenska prevara. Prej shranite sporočila, posnetke zaslona, povezave in potrdila o nakazilih.
when.en: To report an online fraud that is not happening right now: a fake payment link, a fake shop, an investment or romance scam. Save messages, screenshots, links and transfer receipts first.

when.sl: Takoj, če ste vpisali podatke kartice ali spletne banke, posredovali kodo, namestili aplikacijo za oddaljeni dostop ali nakazali denar: prosite za blokado kartice in dostopa ter poskus zaustavitve plačila. Kličite samo številko s hrbtne strani kartice, iz bančne aplikacije ali s spletne strani banke.
when.en: Straight away if you entered card or online-banking details, shared a code, installed a remote-access app or sent money: ask them to block your card and access and try to stop the payment. Call only the number on the back of your card, in the bank’s app or on the bank’s website.

label.sl: Številka na kartici ali v bančni aplikaciji
label.en: The number on your card or in your bank’s app

hours.sl: Blokada kartice običajno deluje 24 ur na dan
hours.en: Card blocking usually works 24 hours a day

name.en: SI-CERT, national computer security team (Varni na internetu)

when.sl: Za posredovanje lažnih sporočil, lažnih strani in prevar s povezavami, da jih lahko odstranijo in opozorijo druge. SI-CERT ne odgovarja na vsako prijavo posebej; če ste ostali brez denarja, prijavite tudi policiji.
when.en: To forward phishing messages, fake pages and link scams so they can be taken down and others warned. SI-CERT does not answer every report individually; if you lost money, also report to the police.

when.sl: Če ste kupili v spletni trgovini s sedežem v drugi državi EU, EGP ali v Združenem kraljestvu in blaga niste prejeli ali trgovec ne odgovarja. Pomoč je brezplačna. Za trgovce s sedežem v Sloveniji se obrnite na Tržni inšpektorat.
when.en: If you bought from an online shop based in another EU or EEA country or the UK and never got the goods or the seller does not answer. Help is free. For sellers based in Slovenia, contact the Market Inspectorate.
